changedPathRationale.docs/program/evidence/closure/codex/PERS: Records the exact unfulfilled seven-persona human acceptance denominator and prevents automated module checks from being misreported as UAT.

fixtures.status: Automated role fixtures exist in module packets, but no named human UAT roster or signed journey record exists.
fixtures.reviewerRule: Each role requires a named person or explicitly accountable reviewer. One person may review more than one role only when each role has an independent journey record and sign-off.
fixtures.reviewerDecision: AMD-PERSONA-UAT-REVIEWER-002 / option 8A, recorded at 34c2e2ec4c. Piotr is accountable for all seven roles, but must produce seven independent journey records and verdicts.
fixtures.defectRule: Any P0 or P1 defect blocks that role. P2 or P3 may be accepted only with a named owner, written disposition and explicit ACCEPT_WITH_DEFECTS verdict.

sessionPrerequisites: Bind candidateSha and verify the running client and server expose that exact SHA.
Complete and integrate the sixteen module UI packets before starting the final persona denominator.
Create seven independent named journey records even when one reviewer covers multiple roles.
Record screen or timestamped notes, positive outcome, forbidden-action outcome, defects and final verdict for every role.
Do not count automated tests, developer self-attestation or a journey on another SHA as human UAT.

journeys.positiveJobStory: Open governed organization context, inspect a sourced proposal, approve it and follow the resulting Initiative or governed downstream receipt through cold reopen.
journeys.forbiddenJobStory: Attempt to approve stale, foreign-tenant or self-conflicting authority and confirm that no false success or downstream write appears.

journeys.positiveJobStory: Invite or manage an organization member, verify the resulting role or access state and reopen it after refresh.
journeys.forbiddenJobStory: Attempt a SUPERADMIN-only, foreign-tenant or revoked-member action and confirm fail-closed presentation with no mutation.

journeys.positiveJobStory: Open an approved candidate, inspect Initiative definition and analysis, schedule governed work and reopen the linked Execution state.
journeys.forbiddenJobStory: Attempt a stale transition or action outside the Manager capability and confirm conflict or denial without duplicate work.

journeys.positiveJobStory: Create or continue a governed Assessment, Tool or Audit evidence journey, review the nonempty output and submit a proposal without directly writing a foreign downstream owner.
journeys.forbiddenJobStory: Attempt to bypass required review, rights or approval and confirm that the UI explains the block and preserves the draft or evidence.

journeys.positiveJobStory: Open a nonempty My Work item, complete an allowed task or decision step and verify the updated state after refresh.
journeys.forbiddenJobStory: Attempt an owner, admin or approval-only action and confirm denial without losing the visible work item.

journeys.positiveJobStory: Use the invitation or token-only Interview journey, submit an answer and verify the allowed completion state without gaining organization navigation.
journeys.forbiddenJobStory: Attempt replay, expired or foreign invitation access and confirm fail-closed behavior without exposing another respondent or organization.

journeys.positiveJobStory: Connect the Partner profile and complete an allowed referral, campaign, certification, attribution or immutable-ledger read journey with cold reopen.
journeys.forbiddenJobStory: Attempt excluded economics, accrual or payout behavior, a revoked membership action or foreign Partner access and confirm policy-blocked zero-write behavior.

humanUatProtocol.completionRule: All seven signOff values must be ACCEPT or ACCEPT_WITH_DEFECTS, every accepted defect must have owner and disposition, and the consolidated human verdict must contain zero unresolved P0 or P1 defects on one exact candidate SHA.

rollback.method: Evidence-only record; no runtime or schema change.

blocker: The accountable reviewer is now named (Piotr), but all seven role-specific positive and forbidden journeys still require independent execution and sign-off on one final exact candidate SHA after all sixteen UI packets are integrated.
